normalization: the recording is the byte content each Go lane produced for every fixture (historical lane: its sha256, asserted equal to the anchored historical bytes at capture; corrected and product-source lanes: gzip+base64 of the exact bytes) plus the verdict rows of the Go steps (exit status, executed generator tests); no per-run value is recorded
Go compiler identity/paths, generator binary hashes and temp directories are not recorded: they are properties of the capture machine, not of the fixtures
